tenant_model: one dedicated Linux VM, one journal installation, one project, one designated plan per tenant

launch.live_gate: all B10 disposable-staging probes pass and the owner separately authorizes enrollment

topology.name: journal-writer
topology.identity: journal uid 10001, gid 10001 inside the writer image
topology.image: built from the reviewed repository commit and docker/Dockerfile
ports: container 8440 on journal_management; host loopback 18440 only

topology.name: openclaw-gateway-and-stdio-client
topology.identity: uid 1000, gid 1000, supplementary gid 10030 for read-only hint and Gateway-state backup access
ports: container 18789 on gateway_link; no host-published port

topology.name: journal-plugin-bridge
topology.identity: journal uid 10001 through the existing plugin service lifecycle; part of the trusted journal boundary, not an isolation boundary
topology.source: plugins/supervisor_v1; not installed by this profile
topology.lifecycle: journal PluginServices.start/stop and PluginHealth health socket
topology.health: SUPERVISOR_HEALTH_SOCKET answers the plugin manifest health request
topology.process_environment: inherits the standard plugin token and JOURNAL_ROOT; source review and owner-authorized installation are required

topology.name: normal-plan-driver
topology.identity: required dedicated execution uid/gid 10003 with a restricted container or equivalent profile
topology.state_volume: owner-bound plan worktree only; no writer database, Gateway state, or provider-secret mount
topology.network: designated journal CLI/hook route and owner-selected provider only
topology.status: not enforced by the current AgentLauncher; enrollment remains disabled until B10 proves the real bound driver path

topology.name: backup
topology.identity: uid/gid 10005 with DAC_READ_SEARCH; read-only state mounts and backup-only credentials
topology.state_volume: external encrypted repository; no Gateway or journal network access

execution_identity_contract.secret_mount: codex_driver_credentials only after a supported execution adapter exists
network_allow: authenticated CLI/hook routes to the designated writer
execution_identity_contract.status: contract only; current AgentLauncher does not enforce it

writable_mounts: the individual worker's own worktree only
network_allow: the bound journal CLI/hook route only when identity-verified
worker_identity_contract.enrollment_rule: refuse enrollment before credential or model call unless every active worker passes filesystem and network probes
worker_identity_contract.status: contract only; B10 worker inventory and denial probes required

allowed: gateway to the authenticated supervisor routes on writer 8421
HTTPS to api.anthropic.com only; enforced by the tenant VM firewall
the operator-selected encrypted backup repository only

network_enforcement.enforced_by: tenant host firewall plus route-level credential scope

allow: the bound ordinary CLI/hook route when identity-verified
network_enforcement.enforced_by: execution container profile and tenant host firewall; B10 probes required

host_ports.use: owner/operator access through an SSH or tenant-VPN tunnel

gateway_state.storage: tenant-specific host directory via local bind volume
contains: Gateway-owned state; no provider key values
at most 1000 bounded row references and event timestamps

restore_candidate.storage: tenant-specific host directory via local bind volume
contains: isolated restore output; never mounted by a running writer

secrets.name: journal_supervisor_credential
secrets.purpose: single-installation, revocable supervisor scope; never a plugin token or owner cookie

secrets.name: codex_driver_credentials
secrets.mounted_to: execution identity only after its isolation adapter exists
secrets.purpose: owner-selected ordinary codex Plan driver; not injected into Gateway

backup.restore_rule: restore to restore_candidate with the writer stopped; verify and rotate installation epoch before any writer is allowed to start
